locator.section: EX overview, legacy status, and EX 1/27/50 semantics

pages.rawValue:
EX Episodes serve as variants to the base episodes. Some leading from or into other, filler
episodes or just combining base episodes to be a movie. The list below explains each one,
spoiler-free.




Legacy EX Episodes
Old EX episodes from the first 3 batches. Poor edits and dub only but they still exist if you
wanna watch those for whatever reason.




EX 1
Changes the start of the episode so you can watch the filler Bount arc before it (idk why you
would but its an option).




EX 27
Combines episodes 27-29 into a movie length episode. That’s all it does there aren’t any added
scene or anything.
Order goes 26 -> 27 EX -> 0.8 -> 30




EX 50
Changes the ending to allow you to watch the filler Gotei 13 invading army arc after.
